# Decision: pause Facebook posts, put the hours into Instagram Reels
Date: 2026-09-30
Decided by: Meher (founder)

## Context
Crumb & Co. is a small bakery in Pune selling sourdough and celebration cakes. We post on Instagram and Facebook.
As of 2026-09-28, Instagram Reels drove 90% of our total reach over the last 30 days; Facebook posts drove 4%.
Preparing Facebook posts takes Ravi about 3 hours a week.

## Decision
Pause Facebook posts from 1 October 2026. Ravi moves those hours to two extra reels a week.
Reason: reels bring almost all of our reach, and Facebook barely moves weekend cake orders.

## Follow-ups
- Ravi to plan the October reel calendar by 5 Oct.
- Review on 1 Nov if weekend cake orders drop.
